items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Red Allen was there a long time after I left. He wasn't there when I first got there.

ctx.x: Red Allen came in during the time that you were in the band?

items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: On that Sonora, they really--the Man With The Funny Horn was very good, but on the Sonora records--you ought to hear them.

ctx.x: That's one of the reasons why the records--a lot of the records had not appealed to the jazz people, because of that. They were a little bit too arranged in some cases and there aren't enough solos. The Decca's are probably the best for showing what you can play. The Penguins were too much singing.
On that Sonora, they really--the Man With The Funny Horn was very good, but on the Sonora records--you ought to hear them. Do you have time for me to play them?
